# Copilot Instructions

## Project Guidelines
- At the end of each session, the user does a "handover" by: updating START_HERE_NEXT_SESSION.md with current branch, latest commit hash, restore point, what was completed, what's next, known issues, and git status. Also updates BACKLOG.md and creates a session summary markdown file (e.g. SESSION_SUMMARY_*.md). All changes are committed and pushed. The handover doc includes quick reference commands and tips for the next session.
